nodes.summary: Let $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(n)$ be the number of smallest parts in the overpartitions of $n$ whose smallest part is even and not overlined. For every natural number $n$, each of $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(36n + 30)$, $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(48n + 34)$ and $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(72n + 42)$ is divisible by $4$.

nodes.summary: If $O$ is an overpartition of $n$ with at least one part and the smallest part of $O$ is odd, then the smallest-even-part contribution of $O$ is $0$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions with odd smallest part contribute nothing

nodes.summary: For an overpartition $O$ of $n$, let $s$ be the smallest part of $O$. The contribution of $O$ is the number of copies of $s$ in $O$ if $s$ is even and not overlined, and $0$ otherwise; the empty overpartition, which has no smallest part, contributes $0$.

nodes.title: Congruences modulo 4 for $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}$ along powers of 2

nodes.summary: Let $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(N)$ be the number of smallest parts in the overpartitions of $N$ whose smallest part is even and not overlined. Let $p > 3$ be a prime with $p \equiv 5 \pmod 8$ or $p \equiv 7 \pmod 8$. Then for all natural numbers $k$ and $m$ with $p \nmid m$, the number $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(32 p^{2k+1} m + 24 p^{2k+2})$ is divisible by $4$.
nodes.title: Congruences modulo 4 for $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}$ at primes $p \equiv 5, 7 \pmod 8$

nodes.summary: Let $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(n)$ be the number of smallest parts in the overpartitions of $n$ whose smallest part is even and not overlined. Then $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}(0) = 0$: the only overpartition of $0$ is empty and has no smallest part.
nodes.title: $\overline{\mathrm{spt2}}$ vanishes at zero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
